mechanisms.name: Static vertical landing page
mechanisms.evidence: Fourteen captured blocks in one #page-path: hero, cover, trusted headline + cards, logo strip, sovereignty headline + cards, capabilities headline + tabbed media, experts headline + service cards, use-case headline + slider, closing CTA

mechanisms.name: Logo strip + card sliders
mechanisms.evidence: mistral-section-slider-logo-scrolling / mistral-block-slideshow-cards-feature / mistral-block-slider-cards are the original Swiper components, driven by the self-hosted runtime

mechanisms.name: Scroll-reveal media
mechanisms.evidence: data-loaded="false" on the cover frame, flipped by the original runtime once the WebP decodes (opacity/blur transition)
